skill_name: Explain why people are motivated to donate to charities.
workflow: People have many motivations for donating to charities. One of the main reasons is the desire to help others in need. People may also feel they are part of a larger community by contributing to a cause they support. Additionally, people may get a sense of satisfaction, accomplishment, or joy from donating to a charity they are passionate about.
